corrections_applied: Katress + Wixen is gender-dependent: female Katress + male Wixen gives Katress Ignis, male Katress + female Wixen gives Wixen Noct.
Panthalus and Astralym keep a self-pair row in the game files but cannot enter a Breeding Farm, so they are excluded from all parent and offspring data.
A self-pair row alone does not mean a Pal is unbreedable. Relaxaurus Lux and Mossanda Lux carry one alongside a real combo.
The Pal formerly listed as "Snock Lux" is officially named Snock Terra (Paldeck No. 163B).
